newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya sells 6.2 bln shillings of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Kenya sells 6.2 bln shillings of treasury bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Kenya sold 6.202 billion shillings ($113 million) of treasury bills at its weekly auction, bank officials said on Thursday.
In the 91-day main category of bills, the bank said it sold 5.976 billion shillings at an average yield of 21.179 percent compared to 6.150 billion shillings at 21.256 percent last week.
The bank said it sold 226 million shillings in the 28-day category at an average yield of 16.505 percent compared to 820 million shillings at 16.510 percent last week.
The bank invited tenders for 8 billion shillings of treasury bills for the next auction on Thursday next week.
